commonRepository.title: Central data holder group repository
commonRepository.body: A central repository is where data holder group registries announce themselves. Turn this on and the groups it publishes are added under Data Holder Groups automatically, tagged so you can tell them apart from the ones you entered by hand. If a code is claimed by both, both are listed and flagged as duplicates.
commonRepository.enabled: Query the central data holder group repository
commonRepository.enabledHint: While this is off, only data holder groups entered here by hand are listed.
commonRepository.urlHint: The backend fetches this, not your browser, so it must resolve from the server. In the default compose stack that is http://dataholder-registry-backend:8084/dataholder-registry/registry.
commonRepository.summary: Listing {{registries}} data holder groups covering {{groups}} member groups.
